task.title: Inviting and removing users
task.shortdesc: Give staff and volunteers access to , change their roles, and remove access when they leave.

step.cmd: Click Invite users and enter one or more email addresses.

info.p: To invite many volunteers at once, paste a list of addresses, one per line.

step.cmd: Choose a role for the new users, and optionally limit them to one site.

result.p: Invited users appear with status Pending until they accept.

postreq.p: To remove a user, open their profile and click Deactivate. They're signed out everywhere immediately. Their name stays on the records they created, so your history remains intact. Deactivated users don't count toward your plan's user limit.
